content: Production voice-agent pipelines (LiveKit, Deepgram/ElevenLabs guides) treat STT partials as speculative: the LLM may start on a partial but only commits to speaking after a stability signal (pause/endpointing); barge-in is implemented as VAD-driven cancellation that aborts the in-flight LLM stream and flushes TTS output in one step, then restarts STT — cancellation is a first-class signal propagated through the whole pipeline, not a UI-only stop.
